hooks.command: export PATH="${MISE_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.local/share/mise}/shims:$PATH"; f=$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).tool_input?.file_path ?? "")' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm -s exec oxfmt --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

export PATH="${MISE_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.local/share/mise}/shims:$PATH"; grep -qE '"stop_hook_active": ?true' && exit 0; command -v pnpm >/dev/null || { echo 'pnpm not on PATH; typecheck skipped' >&2; exit 0; }; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm -s typecheck 1>&2 || exit 2
